tools.name: Chronos
tools.desc: 用于专注与节奏记录的精算计时器，把时间拆成可以观察的工作段。
tools.descEn: A precise timer for focus and rhythm tracking — splitting time into observable work segments.

tools.name: LinSo
tools.desc: 面向线性思考与文字整理的工具。
tools.descEn: A tool for linear thinking and text organization.

tools.name: FlowDay
tools.desc: 围绕一天的任务流整理工作节奏。
tools.descEn: Shape your work rhythm around the day's task flow.

tools.name: GanttLite
tools.desc: 轻量的时间线与任务安排界面。
tools.descEn: A lightweight timeline and task scheduling view.

tools.name: SmartGoal
tools.desc: 把目标拆成清晰、可回看的行动。
tools.descEn: Break goals into clear, reviewable actions.

tools.name: DateCal
tools.desc: 处理日期、间隔和日历计算。

tools.name: MathBank
tools.desc: 用于积累与检索数学题目的题库。
tools.descEn: A question bank for collecting and searching math problems.

tools.name: CombineSearch
tools.desc: 把多个搜索入口合并到一处。
tools.descEn: Combine multiple search entry points in one place.

tools.name: Lookey
tools.desc: 从浏览内容中留下值得再次查看的线索。
tools.descEn: Keep leads worth revisiting from what you browse.

tools.name: News
tools.desc: 按自己定义的分类与来源聚合的资讯台，每小时一刷，避开推荐流。
tools.descEn: A news desk you define — your categories, your sources, refreshed hourly, no recommendation feeds.

tools.name: LinSoo
tools.desc: 另一种把想法展开、收束的编辑方式。
tools.descEn: Another way to unfold and collect your thoughts.

tools.name: Quadrant
tools.desc: 把事项放进一个可视化的优先级空间。
tools.descEn: Place tasks in a visual priority space.

tools.name: Resume Tool
tools.desc: 用于整理简历内容的编辑工作台。
tools.descEn: A workbench for shaping your resume content.

tools.name: Check
tools.desc: 每日备考复盘，把当天的状态留下来。
tools.descEn: Daily study review — keep a record of each day's state.

tools.name: LMdify
tools.desc: 一个面向文本转换的实验工具。
tools.descEn: An experimental tool for text transformation.
